tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The COOLSERVER 1U LGA2011-1U-3CC Server CPU Cooling Fan is a reliable and space-efficient cooling solution designed for 1U rackmount servers with Intel LGA2011 socket processors. Its low-profile heat sink radiator design ensures efficient heat dissipation while fitting perfectly inside compact server chassis.


Built for continuous 24/7 server operation, this cooler helps maintain stable CPU temperatures in enterprise servers, data centers, and high-density rack environments.


Key Features


  • Designed for 1U Rackmount Server Chassis
  • Compatible with Intel LGA2011 Xeon Processors
  • Low-Profile Heat Sink Radiator for space-restricted systems
  • Active Cooling Fan for stable thermal performance
  • Optimized airflow for high-density server racks
  • Durable construction for long-term server use
